# flo-bit Low Poly Nature Pack

The preview models `flo_bit_pine_1.glb`, `flo_bit_pine_2.glb`, and `flo_bit_pine_3.glb` come from the [flo-bit Low Poly Nature Pack](https://github.com/flo-bit/low-poly-asset-packs).

The author releases the pack under Creative Commons CC0. These files are included only as preview candidates and are not used by the Gustavsvik map until a model choice is made.
